Name: Simple Hoarder Chest
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]📦 Simple Hoard Chest 📦[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][b][color=#67E8F9]A home for your hoard.[/color][/b]
Created by [b]xSyy[/b][/center]

[center]An upgradeable chest with automatic category tabs, custom tabs, search and built-in crafting, wrapped in a familiar Stardew-style interface with bright iridium-purple trim.[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]✨ Store More, Find It Faster[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center]Start with [b]120 regular storage slots[/b] and expand your Hoarder Chest using craftable H upgrade kits. Each kit adds [b]120 slots[/b].
The default upgrade ceiling is [b]Hoarder Chest X — 1,200 slots[/b]. Enable expanded capacity to unlock upgrades up to [b]Hoarder Chest LXXXIII — 9,960 slots[/b].[/center]

[center][b]Main Chest shows everything[/b] stored across regular, category and custom compartments.
Matching-item storage in category and custom compartments defaults to [b]999 (Vanilla)[/b], with an optional [b]9,999 (Max)[/b] setting. Different qualities and meaningful item properties remain separate.[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#67E8F9]🧰 Make Your Collection Your Own[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center]• [b]Automatic categories:[/b] Materials • Farming • Fishing • Foraging • Minerals & Finds • Artisan & Food • Equipment • Miscellaneous
• [b]Up to 24 custom tabs:[/b] Choose names, colours and icons, including loaded modded item icons.
• [b]Editable built-in tabs:[/b] Personalise their names and appearance, and rearrange tabs while keeping Main Chest first.
• [b]Search:[/b] Find items by name, category or ID, with optional description searching.
• [b]Built-in crafting:[/b] Browse known recipes and craft one, a chosen quantity or the maximum using available ingredients.
• [b]Quick controls:[/b] Deposit Matching, Organize and remembered tab/scroll positions.
• [b]Your chest, your colour:[/b] Rename the chest and recolour its wooden body while keeping its purple trim.
• [b]Flexible menus:[/b] Smooth scrolling, draggable scrollbars, expanded-backpack layouts and controller navigation.[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#86EFAC]🌱 Getting Started[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center]Robin sends an introduction letter on the first morning after the mod is added, including on existing saves.
After receiving it, buy the [b]Hoarder Chest recipe for 5,000g[/b] at the Carpenter’s Shop. Learning it also teaches the H upgrade-kit recipe.[/center]

[center][b]Chest recipe:[/b] 150 Wood • 5 Copper Bars • 5 Iron Bars • 5 Gold Bars
[b]H upgrade-kit recipe:[/b] 150 Wood • 5 Copper Bars • 5 Iron Bars • 5 Gold Bars[/center]

[center]Craft the chest and kits yourself. Hold an H kit, interact with a placed Hoarder Chest and confirm the upgrade to add [b]120 regular slots[/b].
Capacity settings set the upgrade ceiling; kits are still required. Category and custom compartments use their separate matching-item limit.[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#D8B4FE]🎮 Using Your Chest[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center]Open the chest with the normal interaction button.
[b]Left-click withdrawal:[/b] Up to 999 items, limited by the stored amount and available backpack space.
[b]Right-click:[/b] Transfer one item. [b]Mouse wheel:[/b] Scroll.
[b]Hammer:[/b] Switch between storage and crafting. [b]Gear:[/b] Open settings and chest-body colours.
[b]Edit Tab:[/b] Personalise the selected tab. [b]Sidebar +:[/b] Add a custom tab.[/center]

[center][b]Controller:[/b] Navigate inventories, tabs, crafting and settings. Shoulder buttons switch tabs, A/X withdraws up to 999, and B goes back.[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#67E8F9]⚙️ Choose Your Limits[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center]Settings are available [b]inside the chest[/b] and through optional [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]. Artwork headings display the current limits beside their titles.[/center]

[center][b]Chest Capacity:[/b] 1,200 (Default) • 9,960 (Max)
[b]Item Storage:[/b] 999 (Vanilla) • 9,999 (Max)
Both expansion checkboxes are [b]off by default[/b]. Turning expansion off keeps existing upgrades and stored items accessible, while restricting further upgrades and deposits above the normal limits.
The item-storage setting applies to matching totals inside category/custom compartments; backpack stacks retain their native limits.[/center]

[center][b]Menu size:[/b] 75% by default, adjustable from 25% to 150%.
Automatic category storage, stored crafting ingredients, lowest-quality-first crafting and last-view memory are [b]on by default[/b].
Description searching and Most Used Items First are [b]off by default[/b].[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#D8B4FE]🧩 Compatibility & Languages[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center]Adds its own Hoarder Chest while keeping ordinary chest capacities unchanged.
Category tabs recognise compatible modded items through loaded categories and tags. Bulk transfers, organizing and crafting respect recognised item locks and favourites.
Includes [b]Convenient Inventory integration[/b] for favourites, Quick Stack and chest Auto Organize.[/center]

[center]Supports [b]all 12 built-in game languages[/b] and follows your selected game language:
English • French • German • Spanish • Brazilian Portuguese • Italian
Russian • Japanese • Simplified Chinese • Korean • Turkish • Hungarian[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]📦 Requirements & Installation[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][b]Required:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6 on desktop • SMAPI 4.1.0 or newer
[b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu • Convenient Inventory[/center]

[center]1. Download and extract Simple Hoard Chest.
2. Place the [b]SimpleHoardChest[/b] folder inside your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder.
3. Launch Stardew Valley through [b]SMAPI[/b].[/center]

[center][b]Updating:[/b] Replace the previous SimpleHoardChest installation with the new version and keep your existing config.json if you want to retain your settings.
[b]Before uninstalling:[/b] Empty all regular, category and custom compartments, then remove Hoarder Chests and H upgrade kits from your save.[/center]
